text:
zoe: I opened a relnotes draft for the routing + batching improvements: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/618. Needs: snippet sanity, a deprecation note for legacy cache, and a short known-issues entry for autoscale fallbacks.

harry: Quick skim: dep paragraph still references `redis-prefix-cache`. That was sunset; we should add a red box: 'redis-prefix-cache deprecated -> migrate to unified-kv-cache (link to migration guide)'.

meera: Snippet sanity: Python and JS examples both call `model: 'kestrel'`. Runtime maps to `kestrel-v2` now, so examples will break. I'll submit a tiny patch to switch those.

oscar: Also add a single-line note under the routing table about fallback routing behavior so support has a canonical blurb to paste. Keeps surprises low.

zoe: Proposed known-issue text (short):
```
Known issue: autoscale routing fallback
- Symptom: brief routing to fallback model variants during cold starts under heavy concurrency
- Workaround: pin model_variant on Dedicated routes or increase warm-pool size
- Tracking: INF-3124
```

harry: Nice. I'll run linkcheck: `./scripts/linkcheck docs/relnotes --out=reports/relnotes-linkcheck.json` and post the output. Will also run a quick anchors scan.

ci-bot: PR #618 updated by zoe  changed: docs/relnotes/2024-08-routing-batching.md, snippets/js/kestrel_usage.md. CI: linkcheck queued.

meera: Opened PR #619 to swap `kestrel` -> `kestrel-v2` in PY/JS snippets. Also added tiny unit that verifies rendered snippet contains a live model alias.

harry: Linkcheck results: 4 broken anchors, 1 external redirect. I'll open PR #620 with anchor patches and proposed redirect notes (so old anchors still resolve for older docs).

zoe: For the external redirect, prefer adding a short caveat instead of changing the external URL straight away. Some customers link to the old anchor. E.g., "Note: this link now redirects to X; contact docs-support if you rely on the previous anchor."

oscar: Where should JP localization stubs live? I can drop the i18n file in `/i18n/jp/relnotes/` once anchors settle. We should avoid shipping untranslated copy.

harry: PR #620 opened with anchor fixes. CI hit a flaky renderer test but I queued a rerun. Will merge once green.

ci-bot: PR #619 merged by meera  snippets updated. PR #620 merged by harry  anchors fixed. Linkcheck green on staging.

zoe: Updated the relnotes: added deprecation callout for `redis-prefix-cache`, swapped snippets to `kestrel-v2`, pasted the known-issue block with a link to INF-3124, and added the fallback one-liner in the routing table. Ran linkcheck locally, green.

oscar: I will prepare JP stub at `/i18n/jp/relnotes/2024-08-routing.md` and open a PR. If localization isn't merged by our publish window we can ship EN and backfill JP in a follow-up.

meera: Tiny follow-up: the Python sample used named param `model_alias=` in one spot and `model=` in another. I standardized to `model=` to match SDK patterns.

zoe: Final pre-publish checklist:
- [x] Deprecation callout for redis-prefix-cache added
- [x] PY/JS snippets updated to kestrel-v2
- [x] Known issue entry added (INF-3124)
- [x] Anchors fixed and linkcheck green on staging
- [ ] JP i18n PR pending (oscar)

harry: If JP misses the window we ship EN and schedule a localized patch for the next day. I'll notify translations and CS channels once publish is gated.

oscar: Opening JP PR now. ETA ~2 hours.

zoe: Thanks everyone. Ill trigger the docs publish once we confirm JP status or hit the cutoff. Will post the announcement copy here before sending. :rocket:
